description: `// @nothrow` is reported as the wrong comment form, wherever it sits, rather than binding or going quiet.

diagnostics.message: `@nothrow` in a line comment is not a mark: a mark is read only from a JSDoc block comment, so this one enforces nothing. Write it as `/** @nothrow */`.
